dt_edits.value: Deal fire-type physical damage to all enemies within range and set the ground ablaze.
Fall in battle. Every ally gains strength, magic, defense, magic defense, accuracy, evasion, luck and speed for 2 turns.
Decreases TP cost of Staggering Arrow by 1.
Increases the success rate of Shadowstitching Arrow.
Increases damage dealt by Scorched Harvest.
Decreases TP cost of Loyal Vigil by 1.
Lord of House Falkes, whose bow-arm surpasses even Symon's. Loyal to the crown to the very last.
